prior_summary: Articulated containment margins condition a learned action diffusion transformer. World-frame wxyz poses yield rotated block extents, full XY containment margins, strict Z-interval margins and the drawer-opening margin. Both objects remain represented throughout red placement, blue acquisition, insertion and optional terminal retreat. A differentiable denoiser-latent head predicts masked demonstration future margins at four horizons; it does not impose premature goal satisfaction.
applicable_conditions: State observations provide two causal frames of Panda qpos/qvel, TCP and both block poses, and drawer position/velocity. Known geometry is the assigned world-frame pad and prismatic drawer contract. The full expanded slice supports entry while red is still held over the pad, during its release or empty retreat, during blue approach/closure, and during initial blue lift. Finger widths, TCP-object relations, signed margins and inter-frame displacement provide transition context. Observed boundary ranges are evidence, not hard admission gates.
termination_guidance: The external monitor may accept one observation satisfying d>0.26 m, rotated full XY containment for red on the pad and blue in the moving cavity, red center z strictly in (0.014,0.031) m and blue center z strictly in (0.053,0.074) m, all simultaneously. Gripper release, speed, clearance and dwell are not success requirements. If optional continuation is requested, the retained suffix teaches blue release and upward empty retreat; no downstream manipulation is required.
limitations: This is a state-only learned joint-action diffusion model, not IK, a collision solver or a scripted controller. Quaternion sign is removed by rotation-matrix features, but spatial equivariance is not claimed. Future-margin regression is representation supervision, not a hard safety constraint or rollout certificate. Near-upright, interior placements and nearly fully open drawers dominate training; highly rotated edge placements, unexpected closure, red displacement and failed grasps are untested. The fixed contract, not observation goal-point annotations, defines geometry. Only two observations are available; contact and grasp are inferred, not measured.

config.normalization: unchanged shared complete-demonstration range normalizer; derived lengths use its coordinate half-ranges, with the maximum of relevant shared half-ranges for TCP-object relations and articulated blue X
config.action_representation: shared-normalized absolute seven joint targets plus gripper command; epsilon prediction
config.future_margin_head: residual from current normalized margins, predicted from trainable final action-token denoiser latents
config.future_loss: masked weighted smooth L1 regression, beta 0.1, targets from after-action future observations only
